title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Photovoltaic - PhotovoltaicSystem
description: A photovoltaic (PV) system that converts sunlight into electricity, installed on a municipal infrastructure element (edintfotov:PhotovoltaicSystem, subclass of geosparql:Feature and sosa:FeatureOfInterest). Ranges from residential rooftops to utility-scale plants.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PhotovoltaicSystem'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point providing the geographical position of the entity.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

hasStatus.description: Property. Current operational status of the system, from the PhotovoltaicSystemStatus controlled vocabulary (edintfotov:hasStatus).

hasUsageType.description: Property. How the system connects to the utility grid -- Grid-Connected (net metering/selling excess power, no batteries), Stand-Alone (battery storage, no grid), or Hybrid (grid connection plus battery/other storage) -- from the PhotovoltaicSystemUsageType controlled vocabulary (edintfotov:hasUsageType).

installationOrganization.description: Relationship. The Organization that installed the system (edintfotov:installationOrganization).

inServiceDate.description: Property. The date the system was put into service (edintfotov:inServiceDate). xsd:date, no time component.

installedPhotovoltaicPower.description: Property. Total rated capacity of the mounted and connected solar panels, in kW or MW (edintfotov:installedPhotovoltaicPower).
